title: Income-tax depreciation rates by block of assets
description: The rates at which depreciation is allowed under section 33(3) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, as percentages of the written down value of each block of assets, in the Table in Appendix I to the Income-tax Rules, 2026 (rule 25(1)), for tax years from 2026-27: every entry of Part A (tangible assets) and Part B (intangible assets) with its rate in column (3) and its words in column (2), under its item and any heading printed above it, copied as printed, misprints and references to the Notes below the Table included. The Notes, the half rate and additional depreciation of section 33(4) and (9), and the 40% cap and the 40% rate of rule 25(2) and (7) are sets of their own; the straight-line rates of Appendix II for power undertakings are not held.
